name: Southbay Cafe & Cantina
notes: 1 photo, one printed menu board ("South Bay Cafe & Lounge"); glare obscured the quesadilla's price/description and softened the flatbread name, so those two were kept minimal.

dishes.name: Hot Wings
dishes.description: Delicious wings, fried up nice and crispy and tossed in a Spicy Buffalo Sauce.

dishes.name: Pulled Pork Sliders
dishes.description: Succulent Pulled Pork with tangy barbeque sauce on a brioche bun.

dishes.name: Hummus Platter
dishes.description: Pitta Bread with Fresh Veggies and Hummus.

dishes.name: BBQ Chicken Flatbread
dishes.description: Grilled chicken breast slathered in tangy barbeque sauce, red onions and cheese on a delicious flat bread.

dishes.name: Caesar Salad
dishes.description: Romaine lettuce tossed with Caesar dressing and topped with fresh parmesan cheese and homemade croutons.

dishes.name: Asian Sweet Chili Chicken Salad
dishes.description: Grilled chicken breast with a sweet chili sesame sauce, on a bed of lettuce, cabbage, and snap peas, tossed in an Asian vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Bistro Chicken Sandwich
dishes.description: Grilled chicken breast with a balsamic glaze, Canadian bacon, mozzarella, tomato slice, onion, and arugula. Served with fries or fresh cut fruit.

dishes.name: Build Your Own Burger
dishes.description: 1/3 pound fresh ground beef patty topped with your choice of crisp lettuce, cheese, tomato, red onions, and pickles. Served with fries or fresh cut fruit.

dishes.name: Steak Sandwich
dishes.description: Slice sirloin steak in an Au Jus sauce, topped with red peppers, onion and cheese. Served with fries or fresh cut fruit.

dishes.name: Citrus Grilled Salmon Bowl
dishes.description: Salmon fillet with 5 grain blend, cherry tomatoes, chickpeas, roasted red peppers, topped with chives.

dishes.name: Grilled Vegetable Pasta Primavera
dishes.description: Pasta tossed with grilled veggies and garlic, covered in alfredo sauce and parmesan cheese.
